name: Lookout Cay Oven-Baked Sweet Plantains & Saffron Seafood Rice vs. Pigeon Peas
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point · True-True BBQ & Serenity Bay BBQ
whyItWorks: Oven-baked ripe sweet plantains and saffron shrimp/scallop rice provide gentle soluble starch, whereas traditional Bahamian Pigeon Peas & Rice contains whole legume skins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Load up on the soft Oven-Baked Sweet Plantains and plain/saffron rice with shrimp and scallops; skip the Pigeon Peas & Rice and fried okra during flares.
watchOuts: Whole pigeon pea hulls in Pigeon Peas & Rice
